articles.title: Week 9 Sunday update: Evans and Samuel Out, Kittle takes over in SF
articles.dek: Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel Sr. are confirmed Out, lifting George Kittle to 20.4 projected points and 25% projected ownership.
tldr: Dak Prescott with CeeDee Lamb and Ryan Flournoy is still our top stack: 15.5% to clear 75 DK points in 10,000 sims.
With Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel Sr. Out, we eat George Kittle and go lighter on Christian McCaffrey at 34% projected owned.
Check Amon-Ra St. Brown before lock: as of this morning he is 71% to play.

articles.title: Week 9 final call: Dallas is the best stack, and the field knows it
articles.dek: Prescott, Lamb and Pickens top our sims in the 51.9-point game; we build it, bring back Jonathan Taylor and get different in Detroit and Green Bay.
tldr: Stack Prescott with Lamb and Pickens: they clear 75 DK points together in 15% of our sims, the best rate on the slate.
Bring the Dallas stack back with Jonathan Taylor, projected at just 4% owned.
Eat Jonah Coleman, whose projection jumped to 14.4 points since Wednesday; his price still earns the chalk.
Fade Malik Willis at 16% projected ownership and take Bo Nix, who has the same ceiling at a fraction of the crowd.

articles.title: TNF showdown: Jacksonville's 40% blowout chance runs through Lawrence
articles.dek: Jacksonville wins by 14+ in 40% of outcomes and the crowd is on Lawrence; Washington is our captain and Henry the low-owned pivot.
tldr: Jacksonville wins by 14+ in 40% of market outcomes, so build around Jaguars with Trevor Lawrence in FLEX.
Bhayshul Tuten is Doubtful with a 35% chance to play; check news before lock and pivot to Chris Rodriguez Jr. if he sits.
Fade Zay Flowers at a projected 41% FLEX ownership: Lamar Jackson is out and Baltimore's team total is low.

articles.title: Week 9 first look: Dallas leads, and the field already knows it
articles.dek: Dallas and San Francisco tie for the slate's best game. We stack the Cowboys, get cheap in the Rams game and save a low-owned Saints stack.
tldr: Stack Dak Prescott with CeeDee Lamb and George Pickens: the slate's best trio, clearing 75 points in 15% of our sims.
Eat George Kittle chalk: he's in our optimal lineup 27% of the time, the highest rate on the slate.
Fade Greg Dulcich at 20% projected owned and pivot to Dalton Schultz or Evan Engram, both nearly unowned.
Get different with Tyler Shough, Chris Olave and Devaughn Vele: a 2%-owned QB on a New Orleans favorite.

articles.title: Week 8 what we learned: the Burrow stack we called won the slate
articles.dek: Joe Burrow, Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins, our get-different stack all week, were in 79% of top-1% lineups and under 3% of the field. Our top fade, Zay Flowers, scored zero.
tldr: Burrow, Chase and Higgins scored 120.1 points together. The stack was in 79% of top-1% lineups in the biggest GPPs, against 2.8% of the field.
Our full Friday build, Burrow, Chase, Higgins and Tony Pollard, won a 118,758-entry GPP outright and was in 34% of the top 0.1%, from 0.3% of the field.
The Zay Flowers fade was right: the slate's most popular player (34% owned) scored 0.0. The Puka Nacua pivot scored 25.0.
Wan'Dale Robinson, our $4,200 pivot off Omar Cooper Jr. (0.0 points), was in 45% of top-1% lineups.

articles.title: MNF showdown: Smith-Njigba is the chalk captain and still underowned
articles.dek: Jaxon Smith-Njigba is the field's top captain at 21%, but our sim makes him the optimal captain 28% of the time.
tldr: Start with Jaxon Smith-Njigba at captain: 28% captain optimal against 21% projected captain ownership.
Eat Sam Darnold in FLEX: a projected 47% owned, but he's in 53% of optimal lineups.
Fade Colston Loveland at a projected 36% FLEX ownership; AJ Barner at 24% is the cheaper pivot.

articles.title: Week 8 Sunday update: A.J. Brown downgrade reshapes New England
articles.dek: The chance A.J. Brown plays fell from 79% to 34% since Friday, cutting his projection to 3.8 points and moving New England's work to its backfield and tight end.
tldr: Stack Joe Burrow with Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins: still our top stack, clearing 75 points in 19% of 10,000 sims.
Hold Rhamondre Stevenson in FLEX: his projection is up to 15.7 as New England's backfield and receiver room thin out.
Fade Bhayshul Tuten at 24% projected ownership; the field piled on him since Friday.

articles.title: Week 8 final call: Dallas' 31-point total and a crowded stack
articles.dek: Dallas has the slate's best stack and the field knows it. We play it, then get different in Cincinnati and the late Rams game.
tldr: Stack Prescott, Lamb and Pickens: the slate's best ceiling at 85.9 points together in our sims.
Get different with Burrow, Chase and Higgins; the market gives Cincinnati a 47% chance to win by 14+.
Fade Zay Flowers at a slate-high 28% projected ownership and move the salary to Puka Nacua.
Keep a 4 PM player in FLEX; A.J. Brown is Questionable with an 80% chance to play.

articles.title: TNF showdown: the field captains Green Bay; Carolina's upset is 26%
articles.dek: The three most popular captains are all Packers, but the market gives Carolina a 26% chance to win by 4+. McMillan and Hubbard are the way in.
tldr: Start with Tetairoa McMillan at captain: a projected 9% captain ownership, and Carolina wins by 4+ in 26% of outcomes.
Eat Jordan Love at FLEX: he projects at 68% owned, the top projection on the board at 17.8.
Fade Josh Jacobs at captain (projected 14%) for Chuba Hubbard, a 14.9-point projection at 9%.

articles.title: Week 8 first look: Dallas's 30.9-point total and the crowd chasing it
articles.dek: Dallas is the slate's best stack and the field knows it; Burrow and Lawrence offer quieter, cheaper ways to win Week 8.
tldr: Stack Prescott, Lamb and Pickens: the slate's best stack clears 75 points in 21% of sims, but expect a crowd.
Burrow, Higgins and Chase is the quieter big stack, with Burrow at just 5% projected ownership.
Lawrence, Parker Washington and Strange cost $16,700, cheap enough to add Bijan Robinson and his 20.5% optimal rate.
Fade Bhayshul Tuten at 20% projected ownership; Jaylen Warren has the higher ceiling for $700 more.

articles.title: Week 6 final read: Stafford's stack and the Bears' QB question
articles.dek: LAR's 32-point team total still leads the main slate; Chicago's QB status is the news most likely to move builds before lock.
tldr: Build around Matthew Stafford + Puka Nacua + Davante Adams: 24% of our 10,000 sims clear 75 DK points, the best rate on the slate.
Use Kirk Cousins (mid projected ownership, $5,400) with Brock Bowers and Tre Tucker as the leverage stack, p90 77.9.
Fade Patrick Mahomes at chalk: his p90 of 28.6 is eighth among QBs and costs $1,100 more than Cousins.
Caleb Williams needs news: our p_play is 35% and Sleeper lists him Out, so hold CHI exposure until it resolves.

articles.title: Week 6 first look: Rams at 32.5 and Cousins over Allen
articles.dek: The Rams' 32.5 team total anchors the slate, and the mid-owned Cousins stack clears 75 as often as the second-best Stafford build.
tldr: Stafford + Nacua + Adams clears 75 DK points in 23.6% of 10,000 sims, double any other stack, so LAR is the core.
Cousins + Bowers + Tucker clears 75 in 12.2% of sims for $17,600 with a mid-owned QB, so we build more LV than BUF.
Allen's best stack clears 75 in only 7.2% of sims, so we fade the Allen chalk and the Kincaid chalk beneath it.
Fade Mahomes and Kelce: Mahomes' p90 of 28.6 is the lowest of any chalk QB, and Daniel Jones at $5,200 beats it.
TNF is SEA by 1.9 at a 40.7 total with Jaxon Smith-Njigba's CPT p90 at 55.2, but no showdown pool is in yet.
